page.title: Frequently Asked Questions
page.description: Find answers to common questions about our mental health services, counseling, psychiatric care, outreach programs, and support available through ADO Center.

faqs.question: What services does ADO Center provide?
faqs.answer: We provide psychological counseling, psychiatric consultations, individual therapy, family therapy, group therapy, crisis intervention, mental health education, psychosocial rehabilitation, and community outreach programs.

faqs.question: Who can receive services?
faqs.answer: Children, adolescents, adults, older adults, families, pregnant women, survivors of trauma, individuals living with mental health conditions, and those affected by substance use disorders are welcome.

faqs.question: Do I need an appointment?
faqs.answer: Appointments are recommended to reduce waiting time, but emergency and crisis cases are attended as quickly as possible.

faqs.question: Are services confidential?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every consultation is strictly confidential. We follow ethical and professional standards to protect the privacy of every client.

faqs.question: Will psychiatric medication be available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our psychiatrist evaluates patients and prescribes medication only when medically appropriate.

faqs.question: Do you provide counseling for children?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our psychologists offer age-appropriate counseling and behavioral support for children and adolescents.

faqs.question: Do you organize community awareness programs?
faqs.answer: Yes. We conduct workshops in schools, churches, community organizations, and public awareness campaigns to reduce stigma and improve mental health education.

faqs.question: Can families participate in therapy?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Family counseling helps strengthen relationships and supports recovery.

faqs.question: How much do services cost?
faqs.answer: Our goal is to provide affordable and accessible mental health services. Fees, if applicable, are kept as low as possible.

faqs.question: How can I support the ADO Center?
faqs.answer: You can support us by donating, volunteering, partnering with our programs, or helping raise awareness about mental health in our communities.

cta.title: Still have questions?
cta.description: Our team is here to help you find the right support. Reach out to us for more information or to schedule an appointment.
